vulnerable_code:
class Consultations::NotesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_patient!

  def show
    # BOLA: ConsultationNote fetched directly by primary key id
    # without verifying it belongs to current_user.patient_profile
    @note = ConsultationNote.find(params[:id])

    render json: {
      id: @note.id,
      psychiatric_eval: @note.clinical_summary,
      diagnosis_codes: @note.icd10_codes,
      prescriptions: @note.prescribed_medications
    }
  end
end
diagnosis: The show action queries ConsultationNote by primary key directly from user input without verifying that the note belongs to the authenticated patient. Any authenticated patient can access confidential psychiatric evaluations, diagnostic codes, and prescription records belonging to other patients by altering the id parameter.

corrected_code:
class Consultations::NotesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_patient!

  def show
    @note = current_user.patient_profile.consultation_notes.find(params[:id])

    render json: {
      id: @note.id,
      psychiatric_eval: @note.clinical_summary,
      diagnosis_codes: @note.icd10_codes,
      prescriptions: @note.prescribed_medications
    }
  end
end
